name: assignment-handoff-delivery-lifecycle
objective: Close assignment offer/accept/decline/reassignment, dispatch kill-switch, bilateral store handoff and delivery lifecycle with actor isolation, idempotency and concurrency safety.
truthOwner: DSH exclusively owns assignment, custody and delivery operational state; partner/client/control-panel read only their authorized projections.

tasks.currentProblem: Assignment paths can race, expire or be acted on by a non-assigned Captain if actor/idempotency boundaries are incomplete.
tasks.requiredChange: Prove mandatory kill-switch configuration, idempotent assignment create/reassign, one active assignment/order, assigned-Captain-only accept/decline, decline reason, expiry/late rejection, cancellation and concurrent decision handling with canonical readback.
tasks.targetState: Every assignment transition is one DSH state machine with no bypass or stale actor authority.
tasks.action: Trace assignment writers/readers, execute races and stale retries, fix root causes and remove alternate transition paths.
mustNotChange: No duplicate active assignment per order.
acceptanceCriteria: Accept/decline/reassign are idempotent and actor scoped.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused assignment changes without restoring bypass or ambiguous kill-switch behavior.

tasks.objective: Close bilateral store handoff and supersession
tasks.currentProblem: Pickup can be falsely advanced by one side, replay or a superseded Captain.
tasks.requiredChange: Exercise partner confirmation plus Captain completion, duplicate replay, payload drift, shortage/mismatch, reassignment before/after confirmation, cancellation and operator resolution; keep WLT untouched by custody exception.
tasks.targetState: picked_up occurs only from canonical bilateral evidence and only the current assigned Captain can complete custody.
tasks.action: Trace store/Captain/operator handoff writers, enforce bilateral evidence and supersession, add replay/drift tests and cross-surface readback.
mustNotChange: No WLT mutation from custody exception.
No stale Captain custody authority after reassignment.
acceptanceCriteria: Duplicates are safe and drift conflicts.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused custody adapters while preserving canonical DSH handoff history.
